result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back from every promotion listing and lookup. The full offline suite passes (608 tests). Nothing is committed.

What changed:
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: new last record component `description`, null when not given.
- **`schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(200)` column on `promotion`.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: new overload `createPromotion(code, discount, start, end, category, description)`. The existing five-argument method is unchanged and passes null. A blank description is stored as null, the same way blank categories are handled.
- **`DataStorePart09.java`** and **`DataStorePart10.java`**: the insert writes the description, and every promotion query (by code, active on date, active in region, by category, best for category, and unused in period) selects and maps it.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: a new test creates SUMMER with the description and PLAIN without one, then checks the description through the active, region, category, unused and lookup paths.

Not covered by a test: the best-promotion query (`findBestPromotion`) gets the same column and mapping, but no test exercises it directly. The demo data is unchanged, so no existing promotion has a description.
